vacancy.title: Senior Space Vehicle Mechanical and Structural Dynamics Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Delft optical satellite structural dynamics, micro-vibration, jitter, modal and coupled-loads analyses, qualification and correlation. FEM/COMSOL and modal-analysis thesis background relevant, but demands 5+ years ownership of structural models for space or comparable high-reliability systems, with Nastran/Abaqus/Ansys experience. Senior specialist stretch; no direct ESTEC and salary not specified. Dutch VGB-B eligibility required.
